# Reply.io

Reply.io is an AI-powered sales engagement platform that automates and optimizes sales outreach across multiple channels, integrating with various business tools to enhance lead conversion rates and overall sales productivity.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/reply-io/.

## Actions

- **Delete Campaign**: Delete a campaign by id.
- **Delete Email Account**: Delete a specific email account.
- **Delete Sequence**: Delete a sequence.
- **Delete User**: Delete a user.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List all campaigns (sequences).
- **List Sequences** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of sequences.
- **Reply.io List Lists** (read-only): List all contact lists.
- **Generate ULID**: Generate a ulid string.
- **Reply.io List Contacts** (read-only): List all contacts.
- **Reply.io List Email Accounts** (read-only): List all email accounts.
- **Search Contacts by Email** (read-only): Search contacts by email.
